programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 隨著日照越短、天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #3
programme.desc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #4
programme.desc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #1
programme.desc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。

programme.title: 太空災難 #6
programme.desc: 將太空船送入軌道是一項不容有錯的工作。每次發射都是長時間的受控爆炸,最小的誤差可導致火爆的處境。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #1
programme.desc: 重新檢視新春攻勢: 兩個月的戰役殺死了超過15,000名美國和盟軍士兵,並引發了美國各地的反戰示威。探索報告、圖像和戰鬥片段,當中大部分自1968年以後就再沒出現過。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一。通過新聞片段、任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #3
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見鞋履設計師歐瑪貝利,他正改寫運動鞋文化。歐瑪的 FCTRY LAb 為音樂人與運動員創造創新鞋款,如今他將以 ARCH 為靈感設計全新靴子。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #4
programme.desc: 基努與加德前往斯洛維尼亞,拜訪伊戈爾阿克拉波維奇——一位為 MotoGP 傳奇車手打造排氣系統的工程師。隨著深入了解,ARCH 也將與他合作全新計畫。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #5
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見享譽全球的雕塑家佩姬布拉德利——她親手摧毀自己的藝術作品,只為創造全新的表達。透過火焰與想像,她揭示創作的真諦。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員。馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
programme.desc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來。在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #3
programme.desc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望、正義、寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #4
programme.desc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5
programme.desc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭、其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡。

programme.desc: 翱翔於廣闊的沙漠、巨大的鑽石和​​世上最大的內陸綠洲之上。

programme.title: 創造之島
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密
programme.desc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩、混亂而夢幻的費茲。雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品。

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #1
programme.desc: 艾倫從愛丁堡出發,探索一列奢華列車,與列車主廚會面,造訪二戰與雅各賓紀念地,漫步於莫拉的銀白沙灘,並了解西高地鐵路的工程奇蹟。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #1
programme.desc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #2
programme.desc: 艾倫在列車上享受水療設施,造訪威姆斯灣,參觀布特島上的斯圖亞特山莊,欣賞珍貴的莎士比亞原稿,探索列車工作人員區域,參與刺激冒險,並造訪皮特洛赫里的著名山頂劇院。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #3
programme.desc: 艾倫的奢華列車之旅持續展開,欣賞車廂美景,了解卡洛登的歷史,在普洛克頓觀察海豹,聆聽牧牛故事,體驗駕駛列車,品嚐威士忌,觀察老鷹,並在鄉間享受瑜伽的寧靜時光。

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅: 蘇格蘭 #4
programme.desc: Alan 展開一段罕見旅程,航行至愛奧那與斯塔法,參觀司康宮與鄧迪 VA 博物館,與百老匯老友重聚,品嚐歐本的海鮮,最後在福斯橋旁參加凱利舞會作為告別。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #1
programme.desc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯里的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場「從產地到餐桌」的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事。接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦——他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #1
programme.desc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #4
programme.desc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間。新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務。這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人。而且,總能忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物。深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就。還有,努力無堅不摧。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真。

programme.title: 自然保護區 #1
programme.desc: 領略納米比亞千公里的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景。一同見證超越極限的生命之美!

programme.title: 自然保護區 #2
programme.desc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影。這是一片莊嚴且神聖、亟需我們守護的原始荒野!

programme.title: 自然保護區 #3
programme.desc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點。深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機。

programme.title: 自然保護區 #4
programme.desc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林。這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅。

programme.title: 創造之島
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影。懷艾伯特在所羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密
programme.desc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相。

programme.title: 自然保護區 #1
programme.desc: 領略納米比亞千公里的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景。一同見證超越極限的生命之美!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt faces one of his most challenging cases with Barbie the Basset Hound Barbie has been at the surgery for two days, since she was hit by a car Her jaw, elbow and shoulder were shattered She needs extensive surgery to fix them, but she's been too ill for an anaesthetic After 48 hours on a drip, Matt' hopes she'll be strong enough to cope with her first operation today

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this first episode Alan pulls on his apron and assists vet Gwen as she takes on the case of Staffordshire bull terrier Annie who has a suspected broken leg and a mystery lump

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.desc: In this episode of the Dog rescuers we see Alan return to the one of the Uk's busiest animal hospitals in his new role as vet assistant This time he's helping out vet Alex as she tackles Gladys the puppy and a case of mange

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: F9狂野時速
programme.desc: 你的速度再快,也無法逃離過去當列度(雲迪素飾)與莉迪和兒子小拜仁過著與世無爭的平凡日子,可是二人深知平靜背後總是潛藏著危險這次,他們面對的威脅將逼使阿當正視過去的罪孽,方可拯救所愛阿當的團隊聯手阻止一場國際級大災難,而背後主謀是他們見識過最老練的殺手兼技術最高超的車手,亦是阿當疏遠多年的弟弟雅各(莊先拿飾)一路上,故友再度現身,舊敵捲土重來,歷史將被改寫,一家人的真正意義將面對前所未見的試煉

programme.title: 看不見的罪案(第二季) #6
programme.desc: 德絲讓睡眠不足的辛妮休息一日,然後她接到了一通令人緊張的報案電話,表示有一個受傷的男人被鎖在鋼桶內,而他並不知道自己在何方也不知道自己是誰!德絲與時間競賽,調查著復仇動機及商業競爭,找出即將成為謀殺案受害者的所在並拯救其生命;而辛妮則欺騙嘉爾,取得其保安密碼,痴迷地透過大樓的閉路電視監視其鄰居,深信她目睹了一場謀殺德絲和辛妮在激動的高潮中重逢,但卻要獨自面對後果--德絲出於同情而分享自己的過去,卻因此不知所措,而辛妮則被嘉爾質問她不斷惡化的精神狀況

programme.desc: 約翰諾蘭是洛杉磯警局最年長的新手警員,他憑藉人生經驗,決心與幽默感,努力跟上其他比他年輕20歲的新人隨著訓練即將結束,諾蘭面臨作為警員最大的挑戰--他必須正視自己在追求真相過程中所作的選擇

programme.title: 波士頓執法尊家 (第一季) #15
programme.desc: 波士頓執法尊家是長壽熱門劇集執法尊家的外傳故事華柏將再度飾演紐約警局警員丹尼雷根,而這次他將調職到波士頓警局抵達波士頓後,他隨即與警探莉娜彼得斯成為拍檔,而莉娜則是一個著名執法世家的長女

programme.title: 海狼特警-起源(第二季) #15
programme.desc: 海狼特警-起源第二季深入探討由傳奇人物麥克法蘭斯所帶領,而且勢不可擋的海狼特警彭德頓營團隊,以及吉布斯早期的特別探員生涯,並揭示拉拉在上一季嚴重車禍後的命運團隊面臨全新威脅,更高風險以及影響職業生涯和私人生活的關鍵時刻

programme.title: 捉鬼敢死隊-冰封魅來
programme.desc: 捉鬼敢死隊-冰封魅來講述史賓格勒家重返故事起點,亦即標誌性的紐約市消防局,並與原班捉鬼敢死隊合作當年的原班人馬現已建立起一個高度機密研究實驗室,把捉鬼技術提升到新層次然而,一件古代神器被發現後,釋放出一支鬼魂大軍,令全城被致命寒氣籠罩,新舊捉鬼敢死隊必須聯手保衛家園,阻止世界進入第二次冰河時期

programme.title: F9狂野時速
programme.desc: 你的速度再快,也無法逃離過去當列度(雲迪素飾)與莉迪和兒子小拜仁過著與世無爭的平凡日子,可是二人深知平靜背後總是潛藏著危險這次,他們面對的威脅將逼使阿當正視過去的罪孽,方可拯救所愛阿當的團隊聯手阻止一場國際級大災難,而背後主謀是他們見識過最老練的殺手兼技術最高超的車手,亦是阿當疏遠多年的弟弟雅各(莊先拿飾)一路上,故友再度現身,舊敵捲土重來,歷史將被改寫,一家人的真正意義將面對前所未見的試煉

programme.title: 特警雄風 (第六季) #14

programme.title: 特警雄風 (第六季) #15

programme.desc: 守仁整理房間發現了小時候妮可寫給他的信。守仁表示他將信貼在牆上長達五年,每天都受到這封信的鼓勵。因為今天是母親的忌日,守仁獨自一人前往掃墓。另一方面,監志、圭護、見晴及來乙木家玩的音夢從妮可口中聽到了她與現在有些不同的小時候守仁的往事。

programme.desc: 烏野贏過椿原學園,得以出戰第2場比賽。日向被春高會場獲選為全日本青年強化集訓成員。他看見來自鷗台高中,有“小巨人”之稱的星海光來的賽中表現。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #21
programme.desc: 圭護因為頻道的影片播放次數沒有起色而感到煩惱。他找同居人妮可、守仁、監志及見晴商量,結果被狠狠地吐槽「因為你的頻道不有趣啦!」。為了讓影片有看頭,圭護拜託妮可在影片中串場被守仁一口回絕。於是妮可對圭護施展了讓他自己變成「女孩子」的魔法。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守護者 #22
programme.desc: 妮可在房間內和伽羅跟守仁一起舉辦狂吃甜甜圈的派對。伽羅大口享用甜甜圈並表示碰上討厭的事情或疲累時就是要吃甜甜圈!妮可為了體驗只要是女孩子都曾夢想過的甜點世界,決定嘗試用魔法將身體變小盡情享受甜甜圈。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #7
programme.desc: 艾莉西亞跟父親談好條件,必須將魔法等級升到90才能繼續監督麗茲。為了達到這個不切實際的條件,艾莉西亞把自己關在小屋裡修練,基爾等人則等待著她的出關。

programme.title: 成為名留青史的壞女人吧 #8
programme.desc: 結束修行的艾莉西亞已滿15歲,成了一位亭亭玉立的少女。魔法能力提升的艾莉西亞前往羅亞納村,做出驚人之舉。這件事很快地在杜克的心中掀起波瀾,這陣波瀾最終也動搖了艾莉西亞的心

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #13
programme.desc: 小透在菜園裡遇到一條蛇,原來牠是阿夾的哥哥——綾女化身而成的。

programme.title: 魔法水果籃 第一季 #14
programme.desc: 小透的母親已經去世滿一年了。在打工的時候,紅葉向小透傾訴自己的身世。

高朋滿座#77粵
programme.desc: 大會安排二人進行廚藝比賽前哨戰，朋無奈答應，但天武的廚藝實技高一籌。天武表明早已厭倦比賽生活，求朋一起放棄決戰。慶看出他們在意比賽，勸服二人比拼。二人出盡法寶煮出最得意的菜色，惜二人參賽只是宣傳技倆。

programme.title: 尚食#17粵普
programme.desc: 衛王浪費食物，子衿希望他學會珍惜食物，衛王聽不進耳，還想抓子衿出氣；蘇月華在一帆的幫助下到御前侍奉；她投皇帝所好製膳，使皇帝食用過多葷腥導致流鼻血，郭貴妃知道蘇月華為了上位不擇手段，想廢掉她的雙手…

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 潮州菜中，簡單小食都能盡顯烹調者的功架，鼎爺與阿譚先品嚐潮州美食，再炮製潮州粥，伴以「雜咸」同吃特別有風味。鼎爺帶來「普寧豆醬浸竹仔魚」，留意剝竹仔魚皮及調較普寧豆醬的方法；而鼎爺在煎魚前先在油中加鹽有何作用？二人在田中揀選又靚又嫩的勝瓜，煮一鍋「勝瓜魚尾粟米湯」，以原條魚尾煲出鮮甜美味。勝瓜亦可用來炮製小炒，配上鮮蝦，營養豐富的白玉木耳，亦加入新鮮百合同炒，若想延長鮮百合的保鮮期，有何保存方法？

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 地中海貧血是遺傳性疾病，患者容易出現貧血，重症者更要終身輸血及定時服用除鐵藥物。血液及血液腫瘤科醫生指，骨髓移植是現時主流根治方法，近年推行的基因治療亦有不錯成效。樹藝師肩負診斷與維護城市樹木的責任，被稱為「樹木醫生」。樹藝師兼攀樹師到來，概述二者的工作分別，並提到日常需面對日曬雨淋的辛勞。嘉賓更和同行創辦攀樹比賽，希望向公眾推廣這項專業。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅帶來「咖哩牛肉焗薯仔」，嫩滑惹味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 你睡覺時，會「打鼻鼾」嗎？你晚上有否因呼吸不順暢而影響睡眠質素？你可能患上「睡眠窒息症」！這集有受到疑似此症影響的藝人朋友何廣沛到來，請教內分泌及糖尿料胡依諾醫生、註冊中醫師何慧欣與李澄琳營養師有關睡眠窒息症的成因及治療方法，並即場面診！

programme.title: 五味人生#9粵
programme.desc: 飛揚完成五色炒飯，若嵐果然憶起了不少昔日事情。雙春把看見飛揚煮菜的技巧全都告訴九妹，九妹試煮，眾人大讚好味。若嵐胡亂用方法欲替自己治病險象橫生；雙春只得再拜託飛揚煮菜卻被推辭。飛揚的太太婉君努力下，飛揚終答應替若嵐煮菜。勝天向父親提出辦慈善舞會，替義學籌經費。鎮長為選出誰主理舞會膳食，讓喜相逢與吉慶樓作廚藝比試；飛揚更答應九妹能在比賽中勝出，便收他為徒。雙春靈機一觸，想到在山中及海邊獵取野味作菜。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這回「WORKOUT 2GETHER」首先帶來關節運動，會模仿小貓、兔子、螃蟹等動物做動作。其中一項訓練是要坐在地上四肢離地，以臀部推動身體向前移，但小朋友們與主持姐姐向前邁進都不算太成功，教練特意再示範其中的技巧要點。教練亦會指導眾人利用阻力帶，開展綜合體適能訓練；透過提升肌肉力量，對日常生活大有幫助。另外，節目還會播放AI生成動畫《園丁和主人》的下半部。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 近來千依狀態大勇，排名節節上升，甚至宣言要贏得下次偶像公主大賽的冠軍。與此同時，坊間盛傳千依向阿紡發出演唱會邀請，但千依表示完全沒有這樣做。正當千依為此事感到困惑，她背後竟傳來一把神秘的聲音……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 不少香港人飼養寵物，並視牠們為家庭一分子，當年公屋實施清潔扣分制，引起一波棄養潮，牠們的命運將會是怎樣呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2003年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 某私人屋苑的居民長期受鳥糞困擾，疑有住戶使用高壓水槍清理，但引致污水問題。事主曾向管理處與食環署反映，卻未見相關跟進處理。報料者經社交平台廣告登入網站網購特價嬰兒用品，對方竟以缺貨退款為由索取銀行資料，疑是詐財騙局。繼續報道大埔單幢樓「破壞王」事件，男子惡行升級到玩火！攝製隊上前與破壞男對話，他如何回應連串指控？《女神配對計劃2》五位「新女神」聯同「星級媒人」林盛斌跟大家見面，宣佈舉行全球招親！

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2787粵
programme.desc: 陳法拉為哥哥陳生物色相睇對象，欲逼使他與陳師奶離婚。陳生因此離家出走，偷偷在接龍超市貨倉借宿，卻被力蓮發現。出於某些原因，璟風收留陳生於自己的住所暫住，陳生服侍周到，城安、壯與凌凌亦得到不少好處，並拿陳生與瑞素比較。瑞素被比下去，感到不快。其後，璟風等人卻察覺不妥，陳生因牽掛陳師奶，作出不少「擾人」行為，眾人不勝其煩，成功找到關鍵人物以解決問題，本以為可順利「送走」陳生，詎料……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#14粵PG
programme.desc: 知行拒絕作供，惠知懷疑「海味店盜竊案」跟知行的好友陳柏全有關。惟柏全打算逃離香港，偏偏知行依然無比信任好友，堅持沉默，令思義焦急！此時，柏全突然出現自首，揭示犯案背後的苦衷。為解開思義父子的鬱結，惠知帶思義尋訪當年雙屍案的涉案人士，理清多年來的誤解……少年謝家強涉嫌藏毒，其律師代表他認罪，惠知卻覺疑點重重，不但口供前後矛盾，睿燊也確認家強早已戒毒。家強呈上的認罪書過於完美，彷佛背後有人指導一切。

programme.title: 大生意人#9粵普
programme.desc: 李成戰敗，依梅便離家去找他，令白先生身體日漸衰弱。依梅在路上遭士兵調戲，幸得紫軒相救，更把她送到李成的府上；二人感動相聚並成親。平原去找依梅，讓她回去看望白先生，途中卻被抓進牢房，原來這是紫軒的計劃…

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 雙月灣有海鮮餐廳表明團購餐畀冰鮮料，力推時價海鮮，團隊來個大對比！團餐除了有翻叮炒飯、凍炒花甲，椒鹽瀨尿蝦亦霉霉黑黑。然而最離譜是新鮮黃金貝，竟凍夾腥？向店方反映後，下一道湯品似有古怪，主持埋單速逃！海景公寓的滿分點評竟沒提及房間，難道有伏？約130人民幣的套房被揭床舖、熱水爐等問題，曾展望卻稱醉人海景已值回票價。地道小店老闆有「冷戰式」待客之道，足料燉湯、腸粉亦夠溫度，美儀姐隨嘉洛探店卻被驚嚇？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#7粵
programme.desc: 家聰車禍受傷，文靜慰問。文靜暗中送禮物給家聰慶祝週年紀念。楊光與可人順利過關，正式成為談判專家。家全喜歡可人，可人不知所措，遂找楊光假裝情侶，家全大受打擊，再萌自殺念頭，可人與楊光開解家全，令家全不再以自殺來獲取別人關心。簡潔知家聰於餐廳訂了情侶晚餐，悉心打扮，但家聰謊稱要工作未能相陪。及後簡潔發現家聰衫袋內有該餐廳收據，簡潔開始懷疑。家聰與簡潔往油站入油，職員認錯簡潔為另一女子，簡潔的疑心更大。

programme.desc: 地中海貧血是遺傳性疾病，患者容易出現貧血，重症者更要終身輸血及定時服用除鐵藥物。血液及血液腫瘤科醫生指，骨髓移植是現時主流根治方法，近年推行的基因治療亦有不錯成效。樹藝師肩負診斷與維護城市樹木的責任，被稱為「樹木醫生」。樹藝師兼攀樹師到來，概述二者的工作分別，並提到日常需面對日曬雨淋的辛勞。嘉賓更和同行創辦攀樹比賽，希望向公眾推廣這項專業。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅帶來「咖哩牛肉焗薯仔」，嫩滑惹味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 你睡覺時，會「打鼻鼾」嗎？你晚上有否因呼吸不順暢而影響睡眠質素？你可能患上「睡眠窒息症」！這集有受到疑似此症影響的藝人朋友何廣沛到來，請教內分泌及糖尿料胡依諾醫生、註冊中醫師何慧欣與李澄琳營養師有關睡眠窒息症的成因及治療方法，並即場面診！

programme.title: 五味人生#9粵
programme.desc: 飛揚完成五色炒飯，若嵐果然憶起了不少昔日事情。雙春把看見飛揚煮菜的技巧全都告訴九妹，九妹試煮，眾人大讚好味。若嵐胡亂用方法欲替自己治病險象橫生；雙春只得再拜託飛揚煮菜卻被推辭。飛揚的太太婉君努力下，飛揚終答應替若嵐煮菜。勝天向父親提出辦慈善舞會，替義學籌經費。鎮長為選出誰主理舞會膳食，讓喜相逢與吉慶樓作廚藝比試；飛揚更答應九妹能在比賽中勝出，便收他為徒。雙春靈機一觸，想到在山中及海邊獵取野味作菜。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#77粵
programme.desc: 大會安排二人進行廚藝比賽前哨戰，朋無奈答應，但天武的廚藝實技高一籌。天武表明早已厭倦比賽生活，求朋一起放棄決戰。慶看出他們在意比賽，勸服二人比拼。二人出盡法寶煮出最得意的菜色，惜二人參賽只是宣傳技倆。

programme.title: 尚食#17粵普

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵PG
programme.desc: 清邁有炸雞師傅每天將手放進沸油中，他受了甚麼刺激？有何方法令一顆朱古力升價百倍？盧覓雪、阮兆祥為分甘同味，企圖自製打和賽果，可惜在祥仔旁邊的是被形容為「沒帶腦上班」的C君，祥仔最終能否嚐到黑松露美食？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵PG

programme.desc: 要煲出綿滑靚粥需要花心機和時間，鼎爺奉上兩款不一樣的蟹粥。水蟹的特點在於鮮味，配以水瓜的甜味，即可煮出清甜滋味。「方魚膏蟹粥」除了要烘香方魚煲煮粥底，還需注意蟹膏下鍋時間，避免煮過火；品嚐時再撒上已炸香的方魚，味道更香濃！鼎爺接着帶來兩道潮州美食，「香煎兩面黃」要將湯分次下鑊，慢煎成麵餅；不少人吃麵時會蘸上鎮江醋，但可有辦法減低嗆喉感？甜品「綠豆爽清心丸」口感香滑，用馬鈴薯粉自製清心丸有甚麼秘訣？

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.desc: 喜伯通知眾人放在酒樓內的野味全數死去；九妹為勝出比賽，竟出錢請神打師傅幫忙，飛揚阻止並帶九妹回家療傷，更開解九妹讓他信心大增。眾人擔心九妹的菜式沒法與吉慶樓的山珍海錯相比，永禎想出替各菜式另起新名稱，務求先聲奪人。鎮長與所長試食後突然腹痛及流鼻血，紛紛暈倒。雙春發現永禎藏有大包瀉藥，不問情由便指他是毒害一眾評判的兇手，永禎憤而離開連家。雙春喝過永禎所煮的湯，認為他是二十年前曾拯救自己與九妹的人……

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 另一個千依釋出黑暗能量，不但將阿紡囚禁，更令整個偶像公主空間染上黑暗，失去光明。千依本想阻止她，但這時竟無法進入偶像公主空間。為阻止黑暗千依繼續破壞，學生會的四人決定挺身而出。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2788粵
programme.desc: 樹根要求休假的樹仁幫忙駕車送貨，樹仁卻藉詞推托，並向栢菲提到他堅決不肯駕車的理由。其後，樹仁發現不少好友都轉職的士司機，並提及其中的好處。某位友人要求持有的士牌照的樹仁替他工作數天，基於某些原因，樹仁無法推辭。「開工」首天，為免被認識之人認出，樹仁設法掩飾身分，期間遇上不少特別遭遇，更意外發現樹根遭人欺騙。樹仁本想揭穿那人的謊言，樹根卻不相信。為了取得憑證，樹仁作出多番嘗試……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#15粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知認為有人要無辜的家強代為承擔一切罪責，希望律政司調查內幕。光正遵循建議請示，不僅遭上司施壓，更被要求繼續檢控。惠知不忍冤獄，考慮永久終止聆訊。光正被上級斥責未能維護律政司權威；律政司向方官投訴，方官直指惠知不應該再主審此案……在睿燊勸說下，家強終於吐出所有真相與苦衷，想於法庭坦白卻再收恐嚇。另邊廂，惠知遭刀手施襲……邵文親近雅晴，惠知猜出邵文的意圖並提醒雅晴；雅晴半信半疑下，忍不住試探邵文……

programme.title: 大生意人#10粵普
programme.desc: 侯二求見平原被拒，故威脅茶舖不得購買蘭雪茶。平原拜訪胡裕泰，卻因蘭雪茶亂了徽茶規矩被逐，遂以加一成價格收購全村茶葉，並派平文赴山西借銀。李欽承諾助平原進入萬茶大會，結果當日平原沒有等來李欽，焦急萬分…

programme.title: 試真D粵PG
programme.desc: 深圳的光明區有三寶︰乳鴿、粟米、牛初乳，從網上搜尋三甲，連環試試其中兩間，而雙方更是「死對頭」？就來一場直接比較！這樣一試，讓朱敏瀚放低拍攝節目前的擔心，原來除了劣食外，都有美食。美儀姐接着給予朱仔和嘉洛一項考驗，到男食客比率極高的乳鴿店，嘗試「敞開」老闆娘的心扉，並完成點餐任務，怎料朱仔被對方一個眼神嚇怕！坤哥表明不吃榴槤，製作組就為他安排一碗榴槤飯，嘉洛、美儀姐笑言是坤哥自私食的「報應」？

及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#8粵PG
programme.desc: 簡潔懷疑可人是第三者，一再試探卻不果。簡潔跟蹤家聰，遠處看見家聰和一女子狀甚親熱，但傳呼機急召她回工作崗位，無奈離去。簡潔向文靜透露家聰有婚外情，文靜安慰她。家聰不知有外遇的事已給簡潔發現，仍如常寵愛簡潔，簡潔逃避。家全首次出糧，花大部份薪金買日用品給叔父齊耀、叔母林巧媚及堂弟齊健峰，餘下薪金給巧媚作家用，巧媚卻嫌少，楊光取出千元替家全解圍。楊光與可人首次作談判工作，成功勸服脅持者而廣受讚賞。

programme.title: 五味人生#10粵
programme.desc: 喜伯通知眾人放在酒樓內的野味全數死去；九妹為勝出比賽，竟出錢請神打師傅幫忙，飛揚阻止並帶九妹回家療傷，更開解九妹讓他信心大增。眾人擔心九妹的菜式沒法與吉慶樓的山珍海錯相比，永禎想出替各菜式另起新名稱，務求先聲奪人。鎮長與所長試食後突然腹痛及流鼻血，紛紛暈倒。雙春發現永禎藏有大包瀉藥，不問情由便指他是毒害一眾評判的兇手，永禎憤而離開連家。雙春喝過永禎所煮的湯，認為他是二十年前曾拯救自己與九妹的人……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#78粵
programme.desc: 颱風襲港，眾人希望藉颱風得到假期，翌日果然天從人願高掛八號風球。但因風雨的關係，眾人被困家中閒極無聊，大家玩遊戲解悶時，卻令慶大怒離去。翌日風球依然高掛，但眾人發現高慶夫婦同告失蹤，唯有四出尋找兩老。

programme.title: 尚食#18粵普
programme.desc: 子衿為蘇月華求情，郭貴妃無奈罷休。皇后為瞻基一直沒有子嗣而擔心，故召見子衿，告訴她會立她為太子嬪，子衿婉拒。上元佳節將至，胡尚食要求與孟尚食在百官宴上比試。子衿和紫萍在酒倉查庫存時遇上意外…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 經營近半世紀的眼鏡店舖位細細，雖然「單眼仔睇榜 － 一眼睇晒」，店內多款眼鏡各有特色，還吸引演藝圈「潮人」專誠捧場！香港不乏愛馬之人，許多賽馬術語更已變成流行俚語，學者廖舜禧「出馬」解讀。不少俗語與顏色有關，如「三分顏色上大紅」、「戴綠帽」等，究竟有何出處？「托大腳」原來與中國古代皇帝有關，且聽舜禧逐一拆解。老字號麵店裡，黃耀英「攞住碌竹」學造竹昇麵，卻被吳幸美笑稱「棺材拐杖」，究竟怎麼回事？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 結婚嫁女餅款式多多，美味之餘還各有吉祥寓意，難怪引來「砧板蟻－ 為食鬼」！中秋節臨近，中式餅店師傅講解月餅製作過程。月餅價錢並不便宜，上一代港人還要每月拿出薪金「供月餅」，有何原因？廣東美食仿如「三水佬睇走馬燈－ 陸續有蒞」，但遇見「油炸蟹」、「土鯪魚」卻要避之則吉？乘搭小巴亦可發現香港傳統特色，經典小巴「水牌」更成為至潮香港手信！「寫字人」麥師傅還會親身示範「小巴牌」特色字體。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 擁有多元宗教及種族的新加坡, 在各種文化互相碰撞下產生出一套新的峇峇娘惹文化, 造就了新加坡獨特的手工藝 - 娘惹繡珠鞋、紗籠可峇雅及娘惹心口針 並成為新加坡引以為傲的文化遺產

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 昆達山景色怡人，馬貫東隨三位美女激玩越野四驅車，但嘉欣出發不久即向教練呼救？寫意環境下暢快飛馳，敏之解開人母束縛，展現貪玩一面。四人及後深入茶園採茶，再登上樹屋歎一杯，享受慢活節奏。說到兒時志願，高Ling、嘉欣喜歡小朋友，均曾希望成為幼稚園老師。除了演藝工作，各人現時又有甚麼計劃？夕陽美景映襯下，一行人到可可山打卡，還即席演繹經典影視場面，貫東變身少女大撒嬌！玩得興起，四人更High爆熱舞！

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 輕鬆郊遊，打卡打到盡頭！Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰向香港最南端的蒲台島進發，必吃島上紫菜餐蛋麵、海帶綠豆沙，沿途探索珍貴石刻與奇石，遠觀呈現人形僧人石、靈龜上山石，好神奇！順利征服終站燈塔，任務完成。祖儀、淑雅共度泰式宅度假，打泰拳、泰式按摩與細味泰國菜，不用飛都「泰」識歎！衍峰再接再厲，領祖儀、嘉賓陳詩欣尋訪西貢隱世小島鹽田梓，參觀百年村校、港版鹽田，學做正宗茶粿，認識傳承已久的本地客家文化。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: Hip hop(嘻哈)文化起源於上世紀七十年代的紐約，涵蓋饒舌、DJ、街舞與塗鴉四大要素。谷主凱文指，這文化的誕生時間可精準至1973年8 月11日晚上九時，何出此言？她亦逐一介紹上述要素的特色，並提到街舞的出現有效減少暴力衝突。嘻哈不僅是音樂，更是一種生活方式，其核心精神是「真實」，包括自我表達、反抗社會不公等。谷主凱婷以內地的嘻哈主題音樂節目為例，稱這文化已透過不同形式逐漸從次文化走向主流。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集Gigi姐為大家介紹一道很健康的素食「豆腐煮雙耳」。雙耳所指的是雲耳和銀耳，配合煎香了的硬豆腐，還有腐乳來提味，既美味又健康。Gigi姐也會向大家講解銀耳、雪耳、木耳和雲耳的分別，還有挑選的準則。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 節目組讓孩子們試吃不同地方的早餐，俄羅斯小朋友竟對鹹豆漿、粢飯甚為喜歡？永城帶兩位港孩到訪韓國小朋友家中，體驗彼邦的家庭文化。「韓式飯卷」是當地代表食物，韓裔媽媽引領大家DIY，各人亦會一嚐自己的成品。「擲柶戲」是可多人參與的韓國傳統遊戲，如何進行？嬉戲過後，港、韓孩子還會隨導師學習K-pop舞蹈。兩位港孩趁着「你我」課題，探訪三個不同國家小朋友的家居，眾人直率地不分種族，融洽打成一片，教人欣喜。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 敵人意欲破壞捕捉牆，卻突然收手離去。阿茜未能合體，繼續私底下練習，良太和太晴則表現得愛理不理，舞和伽馬看不過眼，屢次想插手，太晴和良太決定給予阿茜空間，等他自行交出理想答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 兒童體適能教練Yuki姐姐首次登場，先帶來趣味十足的肌力訓練。她將貓、牛、鱷魚、袋鼠等動物的動作融入運動中，令鍛練過程更添樂趣。稍作休息後，「WORKOUT 2GETHER」繼續進行。另一組核心訓練同樣有趣，Yuki姐姐提到會教授天鵝式、美人魚式等動作，做法令人期待。「動物好萌友」環節，這回介紹肉食性昆蟲蘭花螳螂。牠會捕食破壞農作物的害蟲，是農夫們的好幫手。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 全班分組做觀察報告。小丸子不幸被編配到，與說話尖酸刻薄的永澤在同一組。而且，永澤還成為了組長。另一方面，與小玉同組的成員，全是一些氣勢迫人及很有主見的人。被選為組長的小玉，感到很難駕馭他們。

programme.title: 危機現場粵
programme.desc: 本片選取近年來國內最具代表性的安全事故和自然災害，作科學分析，重現處置過程，展現當下中國應急救援專業能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事發原因和調查過程，解讀事故隱患。同時，展示人類的勇氣、智慧與無畏。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 政府2021年提出北部都會區概念，但區內洪水橋、古洞和打鼓嶺等新發展區，其實早於2007年已被列為「十大基建項目」，開始規劃和發展。雖然政府近年精簡程序，但現時估計去到2033年，區內仍會有六成土地未平整好，要到2043年，整個發展才會大致完成。北都發展進程橫跨數十年，為甚麼要花那麼長時間？政府建議設立專屬法例，精簡程序和放寬要求，是否有助加快發展？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻：退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 微退休是指短暫遠離職場，為人生「充電」。著名魔術師甄澤權幾年前於生日當天突然不適，令其萌生休息念頭，還透露以露營車環遊世界的心願。星級時裝設計師姚子裕自揭如何在工作中放空，並談到微退休心態與旅居外地的願景。眾主持訪問一對哈爾濱夫婦，了解他們在珠海經營民宿的微退休生活；王祖藍夫妻另到訪退休人士俱樂部，並挑戰室內跳傘。曾展望、葉蒨文則體驗泰國皇室指定的療養中心；又聆聽旅居泰國港人的「泰」舒適生活故事。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！香港青年乒乓球手喜愛街頭Busking，也參加過不同歌唱比賽；「義眼少年」克服障礙，勇敢追尋音樂夢。兩位素人參加者分別接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 太極將舉行成軍40年演唱會，更接納粉絲意見，精選一些少唱的歌曲，並重新編曲。至於《J Music》觀眾則可欣賞樂隊現場演繹的<緣、<留住我吧與<沉默風暴。「倒轉唱情歌」遊戲環節，請來胡子彤、陳苡臻互唱對方新歌一句，雖然「回帶」結果難以辨認，但正面反應畀到足！還是讓子彤帶來<我獨自升級，而苡臻藉歌聲<擊敗99%！另外，節目會倒數「勁歌金榜」，並邀得許志安接受訪談，分享音樂路上的新動向。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 大廚鄧浩宏帶何泳芍品嚐大排檔風味小炒，包括香辣惹味的避風塘炒蟹、鹹香的啫啫芥蘭爽肉煲，皆鑊氣十足。行仔與鼎爺造訪星級食府，細嚐鵝肝金錢雞、松茸燉水中花，以及砂鍋極品炒飯，將傳統粵菜「翻新兼升呢」。食評家KC帶波波品嚐正宗順德菜，煎焗魚咀、啫啫竹腸魚卜等佳餚以河魚不同部位炮製，滋味獨特。有餐廳推出會員限定優惠餐，包括下午茶時段供應的25元餐蛋麵，以及上午11時後便供應的焗斑腩飯，均配飲品，味道如何？

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 小將張樂兒、鍾冠熹細說投身射擊運動緣由，以及早前代表香港出戰亞青賽感受。有本地龍舟隊凝聚華洋健兒的力量，外籍長者隊員談及龍舟運動的變化。場地單車世界盃在港上演，這集搜羅首日比賽精華。少年三人籃球賽集結不同組別的籃兒，藉競技傳遞正能量。亞洲沙灘運動會將於三亞揭幕，港隊舉行授旗儀式。滑浪風帆港將鄭清然以水上運動大使身分出席活動，並預告比賽動向。另帶來田徑系列賽的短跑戰報，以及體育節開幕禮暨嘉年華盛況。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#17粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰帶人使計進入唐樓一戶救出差點死在Tina手裡的曉晨，曉晨讓Tina說出梁曦害死Simon的證據。文諾為文雅開翡翠珠寶店，他試探曉晨後讓她加入洗黑錢，曉晨想搶走一批黑錢，一幫神秘劫匪突然出現，更發現家明當臥底。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 輕鬆郊遊，打卡打到盡頭！Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰向香港最南端的蒲台島進發，必吃島上紫菜餐蛋麵、海帶綠豆沙，沿途探索珍貴石刻與奇石，遠觀呈現人形僧人石、靈龜上山石，好神奇！順利征服終站燈塔，任務完成。祖儀、淑雅共度泰式宅度假，打泰拳、泰式按摩與細味泰國菜，不用飛都「泰」識歎！衍峰再接再厲，領祖儀、嘉賓陳詩欣尋訪西貢隱世小島鹽田梓，參觀百年村校、港版鹽田，學做正宗茶粿，認識傳承已久的本地客家文化。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: Hip hop(嘻哈)文化起源於上世紀七十年代的紐約，涵蓋饒舌、DJ、街舞與塗鴉四大要素。谷主凱文指，這文化的誕生時間可精準至1973年8 月11日晚上九時，何出此言？她亦逐一介紹上述要素的特色，並提到街舞的出現有效減少暴力衝突。嘻哈不僅是音樂，更是一種生活方式，其核心精神是「真實」，包括自我表達、反抗社會不公等。谷主凱婷以內地的嘻哈主題音樂節目為例，稱這文化已透過不同形式逐漸從次文化走向主流。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 昆達山景色怡人，馬貫東隨三位美女激玩越野四驅車，但嘉欣出發不久即向教練呼救？寫意環境下暢快飛馳，敏之解開人母束縛，展現貪玩一面。四人及後深入茶園採茶，再登上樹屋歎一杯，享受慢活節奏。說到兒時志願，高Ling、嘉欣喜歡小朋友，均曾希望成為幼稚園老師。除了演藝工作，各人現時又有甚麼計劃？夕陽美景映襯下，一行人到可可山打卡，還即席演繹經典影視場面，貫東變身少女大撒嬌！玩得興起，四人更High爆熱舞！

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 永城這集引領小朋友翻開「美醜」課題，先要大家說出最喜歡與眼中最美的藝人，永城是某孩子的選擇？長得美麗可會有好處？眾人各有想法。節目組還讓小朋友嘗試從兩個同品種的水果中選擇較好味一個，他們從中領略到外觀美麗的水果不一定較滋味。三位孩子互相拍照，永城看過作品，決定親自指導影靚相的技巧。永城要求兩位女生於園藝店內，各自選出認為最美與最醜的植物，她們有甚麼準則？大家又嘗試競猜植物的價錢，又可會跟外表掛鉤？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 擁有多元宗教及種族的新加坡, 在各種文化互相碰撞下產生出一套新的峇峇娘惹文化, 造就了新加坡獨特的手工藝 - 娘惹繡珠鞋、紗籠可峇雅及娘惹心口針 並成為新加坡引以為傲的文化遺產

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普

programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄(完)
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 六龍飛天
programme.desc: 李成桂為了正式的投身政治啓程去往開京，李芳遠也跟隨着父親去了開京。來到開京的李芳遠看到了置百姓死活於不顧只為自己填飽肚子的權文勢族，無法抑制住自己內心的憤怒。原本就對於李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁謙將李成桂邀請到自己家裏並舉辦了宴會，在宴會上李仁謙給他看了以他背叛了曾經像兄弟一樣的趙小生為題材的街頭劇。在宴會結束後李成桂為了讓李仁謙保守自己背叛趙末生的秘密，向李仁謙低下了頭，李芳遠目擊到了這一幕。

programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰才是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.desc: Bruno, a stay-at-home father of two, gets back in touch with his masculinity when his wife is kidnapped in Marseille. Instead of the planned holiday on the Côte d'Azur, Bruno gets deeper and deeper into an intrigue, pursued by police and mafia.

programme.title: Heart Of A Lion
programme.desc: Teppo, the leader of a gang of neo-nazis, falls in love with Sari. To his shock, Sari’s son is black, and Teppo finds his prejudices and loyalties pitted against his desire for love and family.

programme.title: A Murder Of Crows Jealousy
programme.desc: Inspector Bruhl is investigating the abduction of a young boy from a playground, until evidence suggests that the boy doesn’t exist at all. Is he a figment of the alleged mother’s fractured reality, or are answers buried in her traumatic past?

programme.title: Red, White And Brass
programme.desc: In a bid to sneak into the Tonga vs France rugby match, superfan Maka invents a fake band to perform for the pre-game show. With the match coming soon, Maka and his friends have four weeks to come up with a performance

programme.title: Catch The Wind
programme.desc: Edith is a middle-aged woman, estranged from her son and now about to lose her job as a textile factory worker. With nothing to hold her to her hometown, she decides to move to Morocco where her factory has relocated instead of facing unemployment.

programme.title: The Kiss
programme.desc: In 1913 Denmark, young officer Anton grapples with duty and love when he befriends Baron von Løvenskjold's daughter, Edith, confined to a wheelchair. As their bond deepens, Anton is ensnared in a web of promises and lies, torn between pity and true love.

programme.title: Your Children
programme.desc: Anja and Frank are holidaying by the Baltic Sea with their two children. Anja leaves them alone for a while, but upon return, they are nowhere in sight. While searching for them, Anja discovers that Frank has never told her the truth about his father.

programme.title: Above the Clouds
programme.desc: After losing his parents in a flood, 15-year-old Andy is forced to live in the Mountain Province with his estranged grandfather. Feeling they’ve lost everything, the two embark on a journey and start to come to terms with their grief.

programme.title: My Killer Buddy
programme.desc: Denni is 10 years old and has a mission, to save his mother from his father’s violence. For this reason he devises an infallible plan: he will have him killed by someone who kills people for a living, a super-killer.

programme.title: A Son
programme.desc: A family’s holiday in Tunisia ends in disaster, when their 10-year-old son Aziz is shot during a terrorist ambush. At the hospital where Aziz is in desperate need of a transplant, the family discovers a long-buried secret.

programme.title: Mr. K
programme.desc: Mr. K, a traveling magician, finds himself in a Kafkaesque nightmare when he can’t find the exit of the hotel, he has slept in. His attempts to get out only pull him deeper, entangling him further with the hotel and its curious inhabitants.

programme.title: The Cave Of The Yellow Dog
programme.desc: Nansal, a Mongolian nomadic girl finds a puppy and brings it home but her father believes it to be bad luck. But when the dog saves the family’s baby, he finally accepts it. Central to this tale is the belief in the cycle of rebirth between man and dog.

programme.title: Last Rain On My Parade
programme.desc: A hairdresser and a ride-hailing driver share intimate encounters on rainy days. But the rain subsides, they meet one last time on the crowded streets amidst Vietnam’s football victory celebrations—caught between fleeting connection and a nation’s triumph.

programme.title: The President
programme.desc: After a brutal coup topples his regime, a fallen dictator flees with his young grandson. Disguised as street musicians, they cross a country scarred by his rule, exposed firsthand to the suffering he had ignored.

programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: In post-COVID Tokyo, single mother Megumi is desperate to find her missing son Shinpei. After a shady young man claims to know her son’s whereabouts, he is invited into Megumi’s home where he soon uncovers a shocking secret.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Pizza Badge

programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Feeling Better
programme.desc: It's time to wake up but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon, Tinky Winky feels better but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - I Can Be Anything
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and follow their dreams.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Fly with Fly
programme.desc: Fly is on the lookout for a very special flower known as a rainbow flower. But when Fly's adventure takes her a little too far from Pop Paper City, her friends have to find her and bring her home.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Pyramids
programme.desc: Dog and Pug find Granny Pug by a pyramid. Unfortunately, they disturb two ancient Egyptian gods in the form of a cat and a dog.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Planet Wobble
programme.desc: Messy and friends rocket into space, but a mischievous Messy sends OKIDO's seasons into chaos! Time to fix this planet wobble.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Alien Television
programme.desc: Aliens on OKIDO telly? Skateboarders in the satellite?! Everything's upside down! It's up to Messy and his friends to fix it!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pig Gets Big
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to go to the hairdressers
programme.desc: JoJo learns how fun the hairdresser's can be when she goes with Gran Gran for a trim. After helping the hairdresser, JoJo also gets her own new style ready for Ezra's party!

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Star Renovation
programme.desc: Venus has attempted to redecorate the night sky, but now Sarah can't find any of her favourite constellations...

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Crowning Around
programme.desc: Rajiv feels devastated when he loses his crown, thinking that it's the reason he is good at anything, but he soon learns that can still be really useful.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Pool
programme.desc: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Banana's Star Appeal
programme.desc: Banana superstar's show is stopped when Pea steals his peel. Supertato races against Evil Pea to get it back but trouble hits when a giant Banana statue collapses onto the stage.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun trying out games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet Duggee's old dance crew and learn that he was kicked out because he couldn't stick to the choreography. The Squirrels are surprised because Duggee is such a good dancer!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - White Cliffs of Dover, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to save the White Cliffs of Dover when Glitch digs for classroom chalk

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch visits Broadway, while the Go Jetters tackle a huge cloud of smog in Central Park.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bullet Train, Japan
programme.desc: All aboard for a high-speed adventure, as the Go Jetters visit Japan's Bullet Train.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S2) - Marina's Mexican Enchiladas
programme.desc: Marina takes us to Mexico, cooking a traditional dish called enchiladas. She entertains her friends with some special guest musicians: a traditional mariachi band.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Orangutans
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to the rainforests of Borneo in South-East Asia in search of an orangutan mother and her baby.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Ship Parts Song
programme.desc: Captain Captain discovers that Sandy and Seaweed don't know any of the correct names for the parts of the ship, so she decides to teach them through a song!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Sidney the Soldier
programme.desc: Krash wakes up and notices a toy that he has never seen before.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Super Sandcastle
programme.desc: Supertato and the Veggies have built a super sandcastle, but Evil Pea wants to storm it by firing her hordes of Mini Peas at it with her pea shooter.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Why Badge
programme.desc: Why do my feet hurt?', Tag asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: One of the first kung fu comedies, this is a story about a con artist who uses kung fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by spirits. When they are threatened by bandits, he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: World Insight with Tian Wei
programme.desc: World Insight with Tian Wei is a long-running international platform for debate and intelligent discussion.
